question: Which groups beginning with dharma and which coverings endow the described arrangement?
premises: Groups beginning with dharma are included in the arrangement.
The arrangement is endowed with these groups and coverings together.
inference: The described arrangement is endowed with dharma-led groups and two coverings.
uncertainties: The specific members of the dharma-led groups are not enumerated in this verse.
plain_english: It is endowed with the groups beginning with dharma and with the two coverings.
